failure_driven_optimizations.finding: An unplanned goal longer than 500 characters crashed EpisodeReference validation after the first tool call.
failure_driven_optimizations.change: Bound episodic intent deterministically while retaining both the beginning and final constraints.

failure_driven_optimizations.finding: DeepSeek could continue exploring after the plan and tests had already completed.
failure_driven_optimizations.change: Complete deterministically only when changed files exist, every plan item is complete, and the latest test passed after the latest mutation.

failure_driven_optimizations.finding: Successful file reads were not represented as compact progress and the model repeatedly reopened evidence.
failure_driven_optimizations.change: Persist a bounded read_files index and skip exact duplicate reads until a matching file mutation invalidates the read signature.

failure_driven_optimizations.finding: At 8000 total context tokens, tool schemas and layered memory left too little useful history and the model still looped through equivalent searches.
failure_driven_optimizations.change: Classify 3500 and 8000 tokens as pressure-floor diagnostics for this tool set and use 16000 tokens for the valid scenario configuration.

limitations: This artifact records one successful stochastic sample, not the three repetitions required by the final real-model exit criteria.
Only the first of the planned eight long-context scenarios has been exercised with a real provider.
The compression ratio is high because protected active records dominate this short synthetic repository; it should not be generalized to larger repositories.
